QuestInfo.name: Treasure Map Hunt Day 3
QuestInfo.0: If you collect 6 pieces of the pirate's Treasure Map at least twice a day and bring them to Cassandra, you can mark your progress in the Pirate King's Treasure Map Book. Today is the 3rd day of treasure map hunting. Mark your progress for 7 consecutive days to receive an awesome gift!
